GL-04.statement: Every current retained A3 proposal receives exactly one visible capability outcome from the server-owned registry: EXECUTABLE, EVIDENCE_IMPORT, CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED, or UNSUPPORTED.

GL-06.statement: Every retained claim receives a versioned source-bound planning record with MUST_HAVE or ADVISORY scope, explicit criterion fields when supported, declared provenance, visible safe reason/next action when unresolved, and fail-closed readiness.

limitations: Storage is process-local, in-memory, non-durable, and not shared across workers.
The registry is intentionally narrow and server-owned; no plugin framework or live provider call is introduced.
Planning does not create an agreement, contract, confirmation, freeze, execution, evidence import, Evidence Pack, verdict, feedback loop, release tag, or deployment claim.
External evidence import is proven only at the pure planner registry seam; this browser journey does not ingest external evidence.
